release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.13 replaces the old first-run launch-readiness wizard and percentage/checklist gate with a five-step Welcome to Tachyon orientation. Fresh installs now get a concise welcome screen, three interactive preview screens covering all 15 canonical Tachyon tabs in groups of five, and a final handoff into the app. The miniature tab previews support hover states, buttons, toggles and dropdowns but are intentionally sandboxed so they cannot navigate to real tabs or change live Tachyon state. Existing users who already completed the retired setup wizard are migrated silently, while the Operations launcher is renamed to Welcome Tour so the walkthrough can be replayed later. Legacy readiness UI is retired before its delayed first-run opener can fire, and regression coverage protects the five-slide limit, all 15 tab previews, preview isolation, migration behavior and final shell composition. The merged patch passed Architecture Guard, Linux Release Preflight, Windows Consumer E2E including the native Wails/WebView2 path, and CodeQL before Stable promotion.
